title: One channel captured (DNS names the attacker's keys), git honest -> CHANNEL_VALUE_MISMATCH
scenario: The attacker holds the DNS credential: a valid DNSSEC TXT names its keys; it re-signs content under its own two keys and manifest and presents the honest git assertion.
base: case b fixture with the DNS channel replaced

mutations.detail: attacker keys, manifest, possession, signatures; A_sig re-stamped

test_universe.like: AUTH-i-T with the git assertion reverted to the honest keys

choices: Model channels sign h(t); V1 channels publish fingerprints, window and profile. 'Captured' = signs under the trusted path.

needs: A staging domain and repository the tester controls, named by a TEST trust configuration.

subcases.construction: TEST issue with captor keys (seeds e10-captor-*), adversarial; DNS TXT names the captor's keys (captured zone key); git blob names the honest keys
subcases.T_derivation: T = nTime(h*) of the fixture's own receipt proof and headers (a_sig and receipt_anchor as stamped; rows 11.1-11.4 pass); U = 7200 + max nTime(h*..h*+5) (A10.1.1)
